events.name: Bash
events.head: Check deck copies, source line, git state, mirror checkout, publish holds and local server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; P='apollo|sendgrid|godaddy|builtwith|neverbounce|zerobounce|instantly'; for f in workshop-plan/deck.html app/public/materials/deck.html live/deck.html; do echo "$f $(shasum -a 256 "$f" 2>&1 | cut -c1-16) bad=$(grep -ciE "$P" "$f" 2>&1) placeholder=$(grep -c 'Add your own' "$f" 2>&1) growth=$(grep -c 'Growth Idea' "$f" 2>&1)"; done; echo ---; sed -n 112,122p workshop-plan/build/content.py | cut -c1-400; echo ---; git status --short -- workshop-plan/deck.html workshop-plan/build app/public/materials/deck.html live | head; git fetch origin main -q 2>&1 |

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check remotes, publish holds, and the live mirror deck
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git remote -v | head -4; git branch -vv | grep '^\*' | cut -c1-120; git branch -r | head -5; echo ---; grep -n -i 'publish held\|hold lifted\|publish resumed\|PUBLISHED' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -4 | cut -c1-260; echo ---; git -C live fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -1; git -C live rev-parse --short HEAD origin/main 2>&1; git -C live diff --stat origin/main -- deck.html | tail -1; curl -s -m 30 "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/deck.html?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/t021-live.html; shasum -a 256 /tmp/t021-live.html |

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm deck is pushed, fetch webinar deck for figures, inspect pass.py options
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git diff --stat origin/main -- workshop-plan/deck.html workshop-plan/build app/public/materials/deck.html | tail -1; echo "diff-empty-above"; curl -s -m 30 -L https://usetantra.github.io/tantra-webinar-deck/ -o /tmp/t021-web.html; wc -c < /tmp/t021-web.html; for s in 'Growth Idea' '99,859' '1,990' '321' 'August 2025' '#4'; do echo "$s: $(grep -c -- "$s" /tmp/t021-web.html)"; done; grep -o 'src="[^"]*\.js"' /tmp/t021-web.html | head -5; echo ---; grep -n -E "spec|done_when|argparse|def cmd_|sys.argv" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Serve the deck on 8799 and run both deck probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; (curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null http://localhost:8799/deck.html || (nohup python3 -m http.server 8799 >/tmp/t021-srv.log 2>&1 &)); sleep 2; curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w 'srv %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8799/deck.html; (node probe-deck.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6); echo "exit=$?"; echo ---; (node probe-deck-nav.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12)
